abstract: In this report, we present a case of a metastasis of an embryonal carcinoma, unusually located in the right atrium, which was clinically revealed by a systemic paradox embolism through an atrial septal defect. The primary tumor was found in an undescended testis.
abstract_ja: 本報告では、心房中隔欠損を介した奇異性全身塞栓症により臨床的に明らかとなった、右心房に生じた胎児性癌の転移症例を提示する。原発巣は停留精巣に認められた。
